proposal.conclusion: The frozen criteria screen for Olônne-18 (chr18:56,534,774-56,536,439, GRCh38, H1) is INCOMPLETE, not pass and not fail. Four required criteria are met on GENCODE v36 evidence: outside_gene_body (overlap_count = 0), tss_distance (nearest_reference_base_distance_bp = 64,426 > 50,000), mirna_distance (1,055,477 > 300,000), and lncrna_distance (336,229 > 100,000). Three required criteria are incomplete because their sources are unavailable: cancer_gene_distance (COSMIC v92 CGC not licensed/ingested), outside_dhs_buffer (ENCFF503GCK not ingested), and outside_ultraconserved_regions (versioned GRCh38 UCR source and hg19-to-hg38 liftover not reproduced). Under the declared aggregate rule, missing any required evidence means incomplete, so no overall pass can be inferred from the available subset. Separately, the measured expression changes do not justify excluding this candidate region: the transcriptome_perturbation endpoint (RNA-seq/DEseq2, H1) has no frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance exclusion threshold, and the nearest_gene_expression endpoint (qPCR for MAGI3, TXNL1, ZNRF4, H1) likewise has exclusion_threshold = null. No exclusion, causality or global safety conclusion is supported.

criteria.annotation_analysis: GENCODE v36 is a new analysis, not an exact reproduction of Ensembl release 103 filtering or GENCODE v35 expression quantification in the publication.
criteria.aggregate_rule: Missing any required evidence means incomplete. Otherwise any failed criterion means fail, and all passed means pass. Individual failures remain visible while aggregate evidence is incomplete.

criteria.description: Candidate interval does not overlap an annotated transcription unit.
Minimum distance to any annotated transcription start site exceeds 50 kb. TSS is txStart on plus strand, txEnd-1 on minus strand; gene-body distance is a separate measurement.
Minimum interval distance to an annotated miRNA gene exceeds 300 kb.
Minimum interval distance to an annotated lncRNA gene exceeds 100 kb.
Original study used COSMIC v92 Cancer Gene Census. Licensing and exact source unresolved; publication reporting cannot substitute for a new computed pass.
Outside DNase hypersensitivity clusters plus or minus 2 kb; track not ingested.
Ultraconserved region source and original hg19-to-hg38 liftover are not reproduced.

experimental_endpoints.comparison: Targeted clone versus reference untargeted H1; independent untargeted H1 versus the same reference control
experimental_endpoints.table_coverage: Significant-only results; no inference of zero expression or absence of all biological effects from omitted rows.
experimental_endpoints.interpretation: No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety. Reconciliation must state limitations and unresolved questions.

experimental_endpoints.comparison: Targeted and independent untargeted H1 cultures versus reference untargeted H1
experimental_endpoints.interpretation: Numerical replicate values are provided; significance alone is not a safety or causality claim.

evidence_rules.supported_for_endpoint: Only a named endpoint, assay and matching cell context can receive experimental support.
evidence_rules.conflicting: Contradictory applicable results must be exposed and reconciled.
evidence_rules.unknown: Missing results or insufficient justification remain unknown; absence of a result is not a negative result.
evidence_rules.H9: Separate cell context, not automatically applicable to H1.

distance_convention.interval_gap_bp: Bioframe distance: unoccupied coordinate gap between zero-based half-open intervals; overlaps and bookended intervals have gap zero.
distance_convention.nearest_reference_base_distance_bp: Minimum absolute coordinate difference between bases included in the two intervals; overlapping bases give zero; disjoint intervals give Bioframe gap plus one.
distance_convention.criterion_metric: The literal source thresholds >50000, >300000 and >100000 are applied to nearest_reference_base_distance_bp. Both metrics are reported. This convention is declared before run/evaluation execution and is part of the new GENCODE v36 analysis.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Identify H1 targeted-versus-control and untargeted-control contrasts, significance/selection rules, gene units, duplicate identifiers, and whether only significant results are tabulated. H9 is a different biological context.

GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Select relevant deterministic calculations. Obtain targeted and control counts, explicit overlap numerators and denominators, duplicate/unmapped identifiers, and distances using tools. Prioritize a missing control or proximity calculation that could change the interpretation. Do not do interval arithmetic yourself.

proposal.conclusion: The measured expression changes do not justify excluding Keppel-19. No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold in the supplied criteria establishes exclusion, and the aggregate evidence remains incomplete. The targeted H1 clone shows 139 qualifying DE genes (87 up, 52 down) versus 260 in the independent untargeted H1 control (194 up, 66 down), i.e. 121 fewer DE genes in the targeted contrast. However, 48 of the 139 targeted DE genes (48/139 = 0.3453) are also DE in the untargeted control (48/260 = 0.1846 of control; Jaccard 48/351 = 0.1368), all 48 in the same direction, so roughly a third of the targeted signal is not clone-specific. Nearest-gene qPCR means are near zero (MAGI3 0.0269, TXNL1 -0.0019, ZNRF4 -0.0210 log2FC, 5 replicates). Proximity analysis of mapped DE genes found no overlap with the candidate and a nearest mapped DE gene (AC011471.1) at 774,116 bp interval gap / 774,117 bp nearest-reference-base distance. These are contextualizing measurements only: control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality, and no global safe label is assigned.

The targeted H1 contrast yields 111 qualifying DE genes (54 up, 57 down), which is 149 fewer than the 260 qualifying DE genes in the independent untargeted H1 control contrast (194 up, 66 down). 40 of the 111 targeted DE genes (40/111 = 0.3604) are also significant in the untargeted control, all 40 in the same direction (0 opposite), so a substantial share of the targeted signal is not distinguishable from untargeted-control variation. The nearest mapped DE gene on chr18 is TTC39C at interval_gap_bp 32,399,164 / nearest_reference_base_distance_bp 32,399,165, with no overlap; GREB1L and AP005119.1 are 35,009,358 and 55,176,833 bp away respectively. qPCR means for the nearest genes are near zero (MAGI3 -0.00765, TXNL1 -0.06707, ZNRF4 0.03753 log2FC, 5 replicates). assessment.conclusion: The measured expression changes do not justify excluding Keppel-19. In H1, the targeted clone shows 139 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (87 up, 52 down) versus 260 in the independent untargeted H1 control; 48 genes are shared, so 91 are targeted-only and the overlap fraction is 48/139 = 0.345. Because 48 of the targeted DE genes also change in the untargeted control, a substantial part of the targeted signal is not specific to the targeted clone, and the control-only set (212) shows that untargeted H1 cultures themselves vary widely. The candidate interval does not overlap any GENCODE v36 transcription unit (overlap_count 0), and the nearest gene body (ZNRF4) is 53,277 bp away by interval gap (53,278 bp by nearest reference base); the nearest TSS is also ZNRF4 at 53,278 bp. These distances exceed the named 50 kb TSS threshold, but distance is not a safety or causality measure. The screen remains incomplete because cancer-gene, DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region evidence are unavailable, so no aggregate pass/fail can be issued. No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, and the qPCR means for MAGI3 (0.0269), TXNL1 (-0.0019) and ZNRF4 (-0.0210) are near zero but carry no exclusion threshold. Exclusion is therefore not justified by the available evidence.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Synthesize the available numerical results and methods. Use tools to resolve missing consequential evidence. Explain what the expression comparison supports or questions, with exact counts and denominators. Control variation can contextualize a concern but does not establish causality or safety. Preserve uncertainty when required evidence is missing. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

The targeted H1 contrast yields 111 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (54 up, 57 down) at |log2FC|>=1 and FDR<=0.01, while the independent untargeted H1 contrast yields 260 DE genes; 40 genes are shared, giving an overlap fraction of 40/111 = 0.36036036036036034, with 71 targeted-only genes. Because 36% of the targeted DE set also changes in the untargeted control comparison, the targeted DE signal is not separable from background culture variation on this evidence alone. Genomic context is permissive on the criteria that could be computed: zero gene-body overlaps, nearest gene-body interval gap 60,769 bp (TXNL1), nearest TSS reference-base distance 64,426 bp (>50 kb), nearest miRNA 1,055,477 bp (>300 kb), nearest lncRNA 336,229 bp (>100 kb). However, the frozen screen is incomplete: cancer-gene distance, DHS +/-2 kb buffer and ultraconserved-region criteria are unavailable, so no aggregate pass/fail can be issued. Of 111 targeted DE genes, 103 mapped to GENCODE v36 and 8 did not (noncanonical/alt-scaffold source chromosomes), and the nearest mapped DE gene is 32,399,164 bp away (interval gap), so no DE gene is near the candidate. qPCR means for MAGI3 (-0.00765), TXNL1 (-0.06707) and ZNRF4 (0.03753) are near zero, but no frozen exclusion threshold exists for any endpoint. No DE-count, control-overlap or distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or safety; the correct decision is that exclusion is not justified by available evidence, and the screen remains incomplete.
unresolved_questions: Cancer-gene distance (COSMIC v92 Cancer Gene Census) is unavailable; the >300 kb criterion cannot be evaluated.
DHS hypersensitivity clusters +/-2 kb (ENCFF503GCK with assembly provenance) are not ingested; the overlap_count==0 criterion cannot be evaluated.
Versioned GRCh38 ultraconserved regions and the original hg19-to-hg38 liftover are not reproduced; the overlap_count==0 criterion cannot be evaluated.
No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold exists, so it is unresolved whether any expression magnitude would justify exclusion.

Whether the 40 shared DE genes reflect shared culture/background variation or a construct-linked effect cannot be resolved from significant-only tables without raw counts and the full measured-gene denominator.

8 targeted DE genes (e.g., ENSG00000263028, ENSG00000272803, ENSG00000274843, ENSG00000275679, ENSG00000276184, ENSG00000278211, ENSG00000285408, ENSG00000288136) map to noncanonical/alt-scaffold source chromosomes and remain unmapped in GENCODE v36, so proximity claims cover only the 103 mapped genes.
The all-measured-genes denominator is null; the fraction of the transcriptome affected cannot be computed.
Whether the near-zero qPCR means for MAGI3, TXNL1 and ZNRF4 indicate absence of effect or simply lack of power is unresolved; no exclusion threshold is defined.
limitations: Significant-only tables: no raw counts, no nonsignificant rows, and no inference of zero expression or absence of biological effects from omitted rows.
GRCh38 is a reference assembly, not a personalized H1 genome; the candidate is a publication-derived shortlist interval, not a newly discovered locus.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Synthesize the available numerical results and methods. Use tools to resolve missing consequential evidence. Explain what the expression comparison supports or questions, with exact counts and denominators. Control variation can contextualize a concern but does not establish causality or safety. Preserve uncertainty when required evidence is missing. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

The targeted H1 contrast yields 111 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (54 up, 57 down) at |log2FC|>=1 and FDR<=0.01, while the independent untargeted H1 contrast yields 260 DE genes; 40 genes are shared, giving an overlap fraction of 40/111 = 0.36036036036036034, with 71 targeted-only genes. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Independently challenge numerical claims, denominators, control awareness, applicability to H1, and unsupported biological conclusions. Reconcile contradictions explicitly. Do not turn absent results into failures or label suitability established. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

experimental_endpoint_results.reason: The measured expression changes do not justify excluding the Pansio-1 candidate region. In H1 human embryonic stem cells (GRCh38, data_version autio-79592-v2-gencode36-comp-pseudo-2026-09-26), the targeted clone versus reference untargeted H1 contrast yields 96 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (48 up, 48 down) at |log2FC|>=1 and FDR<=0.01, while the independent untargeted H1 versus the same reference control yields 260 DE genes. The two significant-only sets share 31 genes (31/96 = 0.3229 of targeted; 31/260 = 0.1192 of control; Jaccard 31/325 = 0.0954), all 31 in the same direction, leaving 65 targeted-only genes. Because roughly a third of the targeted DE set is also recovered by an independent untargeted culture, the targeted DE signal is not separable from background culture/reference variation on this evidence alone. Genomic context is permissive on the criteria that could be computed: the candidate overlaps no GENCODE v36 transcription unit (overlap_count 0), the nearest gene body (MAGI3, ENSG00000081026.19) has a Bioframe interval gap of 50000 bp and a nearest-reference-base distance of 50001 bp, and the nearest transcript TSS is 50001 bp away. The nearest mapped DE gene (BX679664.2, ENSG00000237349.1) is 4352715 bp away by interval gap. However, the screen is incomplete: cancer-gene (COSMIC v92), DNase hypersensitivity buffer and ultraconserved-region criteria are unavailable, so no aggregate pass/fail can be assigned. No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety, and the qPCR means for MAGI3 (0.0531), TXNL1 (-0.0462) and ZNRF4 (-0.0121) are near zero without an exclusion threshold. Exclusion is therefore not justified by the available evidence.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Synthesize the available numerical results and methods. Use tools to resolve missing consequential evidence. Explain what the expression comparison supports or questions, with exact counts and denominators. Control variation can contextualize a concern but does not establish causality or safety. Preserve uncertainty when required evidence is missing. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

proposal.conclusion: The measured expression changes do not justify excluding the Pansio-1 candidate region. In H1 human embryonic stem cells (GRCh38, data_version autio-79592-v2-gencode36-comp-pseudo-2026-09-26), the targeted clone versus reference untargeted H1 contrast yields 96 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (48 up, 48 down) at |log2FC|>=1 and FDR<=0.01, while the independent untargeted H1 versus the same reference control yields 260 DE genes. The two significant-only sets share 31 genes (31/96 = 0.3229 of targeted; 31/260 = 0.1192 of control; Jaccard 31/325 = 0.0954), all 31 in the same direction, leaving 65 targeted-only genes. Because roughly a third of the targeted DE set is also recovered by an independent untargeted culture, the targeted DE signal is not separable from background culture/reference variation on this evidence alone. Genomic context is permissive on the criteria that could be computed: the candidate overlaps no GENCODE v36 transcription unit (overlap_count 0), the nearest gene body (MAGI3, ENSG00000081026.19) has a Bioframe interval gap of 50000 bp and a nearest-reference-base distance of 50001 bp, and the nearest transcript TSS is 50001 bp away. The nearest mapped DE gene (BX679664.2, ENSG00000237349.1) is 4352715 bp away by interval gap. However, the screen is incomplete: cancer-gene (COSMIC v92), DNase hypersensitivity buffer and ultraconserved-region criteria are unavailable, so no aggregate pass/fail can be assigned. No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety, and the qPCR means for MAGI3 (0.0531), TXNL1 (-0.0462) and ZNRF4 (-0.0121) are near zero without an exclusion threshold. Exclusion is therefore not justified by the available evidence.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Independently challenge numerical claims, denominators, control awareness, applicability to H1, and unsupported biological conclusions. Reconcile contradictions explicitly. Do not turn absent results into failures or label suitability established. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Independently challenge numerical claims, denominators, control awareness, applicability to H1, and unsupported biological conclusions. Reconcile contradictions explicitly. Do not turn absent results into failures or label suitability established. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety, and the named criteria screen is incomplete because cancer-gene, DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region evidence are unavailable. GENCODE v36 (a new analysis, not a reproduction of Ensembl release 103 / GENCODE v35 quantification) shows no gene-body overlap (gap 53,277 bp; nearest TSS base distance 53,278 bp to ZNRF4), but these distances are not safety evidence. Of the 139 targeted DE IDs, 130 map to GENCODE v36 canonical chromosomes; the nearest mapped DE gene body is 774,116 bp away, and 9 IDs remain unmapped. The publication-derived shortlist status, reference-assembly (not personalized H1 genome) status, and provisional unknowns are preserved. Overall suitability is not established.
unresolved_questions: No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold exists to convert the 139 targeted / 260 control / 48 shared counts into an exclusion decision.
The 48 shared DE genes are shared with an independent untargeted H1 contrast; whether this reflects shared culture/background variation rather than candidate-specific perturbation is unresolved.
9 of 139 targeted DE IDs are unmapped to GENCODE v36 canonical chromosomes, so proximity claims cover only the 130 mapped IDs.
The source workbook contains 139 qualifying rows while the article prose reports 119; this discrepancy is unresolved and no rows were removed to force agreement.

COSMIC v92 Cancer Gene Census coordinates/licensing, the ENCFF503GCK DHS track with assembly provenance, and versioned GRCh38 ultraconserved regions remain unavailable, so three required criteria are incomplete.
qPCR means for MAGI3 (0.026878135623718942), TXNL1 (-0.0019112869264364062) and ZNRF4 (-0.02098838498106856) are near zero but carry no frozen exclusion threshold and no significance/causality claim.

Whether the observed transcriptome changes are causally attributable to the candidate region rather than to clone derivation, construct presence (CASP9 is in the targeting construct) or culture history is unresolved.

Expression tables are significant-only DEseq2 results; omitted rows do not imply zero expression or absence of biological effects.

Cancer-gene, DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region criteria are unavailable, so the named-criteria screen is incomplete and no aggregate pass/fail is asserted.
9 unmapped DE IDs (noncanonical/patched contigs) limit proximity claims to the 130 mapped genes.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Publish a concise inspectable synthesis scoped to the named endpoint and assay. Include evidence IDs and remaining limitations. Label publication-derived shortlist, deterministic operational versus real model mode, and provisional unknowns faithfully. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

The targeted H1 clone versus reference untargeted H1 RNA-seq/DEseq2 contrast yields 139 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes, while the independent untargeted H1 versus the same reference control yields 260; 48 genes are shared, so 91 are targeted-only and the control-overlap fraction is 48/139 = 0.34532374100719426. No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety, and the named criteria screen is incomplete because cancer-gene, DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region evidence are unavailable. Of the 139 targeted DE IDs, 130 map to GENCODE v36 canonical chromosomes; the nearest mapped DE gene body is 774,116 bp away, and 9 IDs remain unmapped. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Publish a concise inspectable synthesis scoped to the named endpoint and assay. Include evidence IDs and remaining limitations. Label publication-derived shortlist, deterministic operational versus real model mode, and provisional unknowns faithfully. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Publish a concise inspectable synthesis scoped to the named endpoint and assay. Include evidence IDs and remaining limitations. Label publication-derived shortlist, deterministic operational versus real model mode, and provisional unknowns faithfully. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

proposal.conclusion: For the publication-derived shortlist candidate Pansio-1 (GRCh38 chr1:113,339,960-113,340,514, zero-based half-open; H1 human embryonic stem cells; data_version autio-79592-v2-gencode36-comp-pseudo-2026-09-26), the measured expression changes do NOT justify excluding the region. The targeted H1 clone shows 96 significant versioned-Ensembl DE genes (48 up / 48 down) versus reference untargeted H1, while the independent untargeted H1 contrast shows 260 DE genes; 31 genes are shared and 65 are targeted-only, giving a targeted overlap fraction of 0.3229. Because 31/96 targeted DE genes also change in the independent untargeted control, the targeted DE set is not specific to the targeted clone, and no frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or safety. The GENCODE v36 screen is incomplete: outside_gene_body, tss_distance, mirna_distance and lncrna_distance pass, but cancer_gene_distance, outside_dhs_buffer and outside_ultraconserved_regions are unavailable, so the aggregate rule yields incomplete rather than pass/fail. The nearest gene body (MAGI3) has a Bioframe interval gap of 50,000 bp and a nearest-reference-base distance of 50,001 bp; the nearest mapped DE gene (BX679664.2) is 4,352,715 bp away (interval gap). Six DE identifiers are unmapped to canonical GENCODE v36 chromosomes, so proximity claims cover only the 90 mapped DE genes. GRCh38 is a reference assembly, not a personalized H1 genome. Overall suitability is not established and the exclusion decision remains not justified by available evidence.

The two significant-only sets share 31 genes (31/96 = 0.3229 of targeted; 31/260 = 0.1192 of control; Jaccard 31/325 = 0.0954), all 31 in the same direction, leaving 65 targeted-only genes. Because roughly a third of the targeted DE set is also recovered by an independent untargeted culture, the targeted DE signal is not separable from background culture/reference variation on this evidence alone. Genomic context is permissive on the criteria that could be computed: the candidate overlaps no GENCODE v36 transcription unit (overlap_count 0), the nearest gene body (MAGI3, ENSG00000081026.19) has a Bioframe interval gap of 50000 bp and a nearest-reference-base distance of 50001 bp, and the nearest transcript TSS is 50001 bp away. The nearest mapped DE gene (BX679664.2, ENSG00000237349.1) is 4352715 bp away by interval gap. However, the screen is incomplete: cancer-gene (COSMIC v92), DNase hypersensitivity buffer and ultraconserved-region criteria are unavailable, so no aggregate pass/fail can be assigned. No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety, and the qPCR means for MAGI3 (0.0531), TXNL1 (-0.0462) and ZNRF4 (-0.0121) are near zero without an exclusion threshold. Exclusion is therefore not justified by the available evidence.

criteria.source_section: Materials and methods: In silico search for putative GSH
criteria.annotation_analysis: GENCODE v36 is a new analysis, not an exact reproduction of Ensembl release 103 filtering or GENCODE v35 expression quantification in the publication.
criteria.aggregate_rule: Missing any required evidence means incomplete. Otherwise any failed criterion means fail, and all passed means pass. Individual failures remain visible while aggregate evidence is incomplete.

criteria.description: Candidate interval does not overlap an annotated transcription unit.
Minimum distance to any annotated transcription start site exceeds 50 kb. TSS is txStart on plus strand, txEnd-1 on minus strand; gene-body distance is a separate measurement.
Minimum interval distance to an annotated miRNA gene exceeds 300 kb.
Minimum interval distance to an annotated lncRNA gene exceeds 100 kb.
Original study used COSMIC v92 Cancer Gene Census. Licensing and exact source unresolved; publication reporting cannot substitute for a new computed pass.
Outside DNase hypersensitivity clusters plus or minus 2 kb; track not ingested.
Ultraconserved region source and original hg19-to-hg38 liftover are not reproduced.

experimental_endpoints.comparison: Targeted clone versus reference untargeted H1; independent untargeted H1 versus the same reference control
experimental_endpoints.table_coverage: Significant-only results; no inference of zero expression or absence of all biological effects from omitted rows.
experimental_endpoints.interpretation: No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety. Reconciliation must state limitations and unresolved questions.

experimental_endpoints.comparison: Targeted and independent untargeted H1 cultures versus reference untargeted H1
experimental_endpoints.interpretation: Numerical replicate values are provided; significance alone is not a safety or causality claim.

evidence_rules.supported_for_endpoint: Only a named endpoint, assay and matching cell context can receive experimental support.
evidence_rules.conflicting: Contradictory applicable results must be exposed and reconciled.
evidence_rules.unknown: Missing results or insufficient justification remain unknown; absence of a result is not a negative result.
evidence_rules.H9: Separate cell context, not automatically applicable to H1.

distance_convention.interval_gap_bp: Bioframe distance: unoccupied coordinate gap between zero-based half-open intervals; overlaps and bookended intervals have gap zero.
distance_convention.nearest_reference_base_distance_bp: Minimum absolute coordinate difference between bases included in the two intervals; overlapping bases give zero; disjoint intervals give Bioframe gap plus one.
distance_convention.criterion_metric: The literal source thresholds >50000, >300000 and >100000 are applied to nearest_reference_base_distance_bp. Both metrics are reported. This convention is declared before run/evaluation execution and is part of the new GENCODE v36 analysis.

Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Read the named criteria and their parameters. Report all required missing criteria, including unavailable cancer-gene/regulatory evidence. Never infer an overall pass from the available subset.

Under the declared aggregate rule, missing any required evidence means the aggregate is incomplete, so no pass/fail aggregate can be assigned and the region cannot be excluded on this evidence. The measured expression endpoints carry no frozen exclusion threshold, so they do not justify exclusion either.

outside_dhs_buffer (ENCFF503GCK DNase hypersensitivity clusters +/- 2 kb, overlap_count == 0) is unavailable; track not ingested.
outside_ultraconserved_regions (versioned GRCh38 ultraconserved regions, overlap_count == 0) is unavailable; original hg19-to-hg38 liftover not reproduced.
Whether the publication's Ensembl release 103 filtering / GENCODE v35 expression quantification would give the same distances as this new GENCODE v36 analysis is unknown.

proposal.conclusion: The frozen criteria screen for Olônne-18 (chr18:56,534,774-56,536,439, GRCh38, H1) is INCOMPLETE, not pass and not fail. Four required criteria are met on GENCODE v36 evidence: outside_gene_body (overlap_count = 0), tss_distance (nearest_reference_base_distance_bp = 64,426 > 50,000), mirna_distance (1,055,477 > 300,000), and lncrna_distance (336,229 > 100,000). Three required criteria are incomplete because their sources are unavailable: cancer_gene_distance (COSMIC v92 CGC not licensed/ingested), outside_dhs_buffer (ENCFF503GCK not ingested), and outside_ultraconserved_regions (versioned GRCh38 UCR source and hg19-to-hg38 liftover not reproduced). Under the declared aggregate rule, missing any required evidence means incomplete, so no overall pass can be inferred from the available subset. Separately, the measured expression changes do not justify excluding this candidate region: the transcriptome_perturbation endpoint (RNA-seq/DEseq2, H1) has no frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance exclusion threshold, and the nearest_gene_expression endpoint (qPCR for MAGI3, TXNL1, ZNRF4, H1) likewise has exclusion_threshold = null. No exclusion, causality or global safety conclusion is supported.

proposal.conclusion: The available evidence does not justify excluding candidate olonne-18. What is available is: (1) a publication-derived GRCh38 candidate interval, (2) two H1 significant-only DEseq2 expression tables (targeted candidate clone vs reference untargeted H1; independent untargeted H1 vs the same reference control), (3) an H1 qPCR replicate table for MAGI3/TXNL1/ZNRF4, (4) a frozen GENCODE v36 annotation window, and (5) a reference-sequence window. No exclusion threshold is defined for either endpoint, both expression tables are significant-only (no raw counts, no non-significant rows), and three required criteria inputs (COSMIC cancer-gene coordinates, DHS exclusion track, ultraconserved regions) are unavailable. Control overlap and genomic proximity cannot establish safety or causality, and no global safe label is assigned. Aggregate criteria evidence is therefore incomplete, and the expression evidence alone does not support exclusion.
unresolved_questions: Do the 111 significant targeted-vs-control rows and 260 significant untargeted-vs-control rows contain any gene whose perturbation is attributable to the candidate region rather than to clone/culture background? (No causality test is available.)
What are the non-significant and raw-count values for all measured genes? Both tables are significant-only, so absence of a row is not evidence of no expression change.

How many of the 111 and 260 rows are shared between the targeted and untargeted contrasts (e.g. ENSG00000258993.1, ENSG00000284655.1, ENSG00000205362.11/MT1A appear in both), and does that overlap indicate shared background rather than candidate-specific effect?
What are the GENCODE v36 gene-body, TSS, miRNA and lncRNA distances for the candidate interval? The annotation window is available but no distance computation was returned in this task.
What are the COSMIC v92 Cancer Gene Census, ENCFF503GCK DHS, and versioned ultraconserved-region results? All three are unavailable, so those criteria cannot be evaluated.
What are the H1 qPCR replicate values in source:supp4 for MAGI3, TXNL1 and ZNRF4, and do they agree with the RNA-seq direction?
Do the non-canonical contig rows in the untargeted table (e.g. CHR_HG76_PATCH, CHR_HSCHR16_3_CTG1) affect gene-unit deduplication?

criteria.source_section: Materials and methods: In silico search for putative GSH
criteria.annotation_analysis: GENCODE v36 is a new analysis, not an exact reproduction of Ensembl release 103 filtering or GENCODE v35 expression quantification in the publication.
criteria.aggregate_rule: Missing any required evidence means incomplete. Otherwise any failed criterion means fail, and all passed means pass. Individual failures remain visible while aggregate evidence is incomplete.

criteria.description: Candidate interval does not overlap an annotated transcription unit.
Minimum distance to any annotated transcription start site exceeds 50 kb. TSS is txStart on plus strand, txEnd-1 on minus strand; gene-body distance is a separate measurement.
Minimum interval distance to an annotated miRNA gene exceeds 300 kb.
Minimum interval distance to an annotated lncRNA gene exceeds 100 kb.
Original study used COSMIC v92 Cancer Gene Census. Licensing and exact source unresolved; publication reporting cannot substitute for a new computed pass.
Outside DNase hypersensitivity clusters plus or minus 2 kb; track not ingested.
Ultraconserved region source and original hg19-to-hg38 liftover are not reproduced.

experimental_endpoints.comparison: Targeted clone versus reference untargeted H1; independent untargeted H1 versus the same reference control
experimental_endpoints.table_coverage: Significant-only results; no inference of zero expression or absence of all biological effects from omitted rows.
experimental_endpoints.interpretation: No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety. Reconciliation must state limitations and unresolved questions.

experimental_endpoints.comparison: Targeted and independent untargeted H1 cultures versus reference untargeted H1
experimental_endpoints.interpretation: Numerical replicate values are provided; significance alone is not a safety or causality claim.

evidence_rules.supported_for_endpoint: Only a named endpoint, assay and matching cell context can receive experimental support.
evidence_rules.conflicting: Contradictory applicable results must be exposed and reconciled.
evidence_rules.unknown: Missing results or insufficient justification remain unknown; absence of a result is not a negative result.
evidence_rules.H9: Separate cell context, not automatically applicable to H1.

distance_convention.interval_gap_bp: Bioframe distance: unoccupied coordinate gap between zero-based half-open intervals; overlaps and bookended intervals have gap zero.
distance_convention.nearest_reference_base_distance_bp: Minimum absolute coordinate difference between bases included in the two intervals; overlapping bases give zero; disjoint intervals give Bioframe gap plus one.
distance_convention.criterion_metric: The literal source thresholds >50000, >300000 and >100000 are applied to nearest_reference_base_distance_bp. Both metrics are reported. This convention is declared before run/evaluation execution and is part of the new GENCODE v36 analysis.

task_limits.tool_allowance_includes: Both scientific tools and retrieve_evidence; the run-level limit is not this task's allowance.

proposal.conclusion: The measured expression changes do not justify excluding Keppel-19. No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold in the supplied criteria establishes exclusion, and the aggregate evidence remains incomplete. The targeted H1 clone shows 139 qualifying DE genes (87 up, 52 down) versus 260 in the independent untargeted H1 control (194 up, 66 down), i.e. 121 fewer DE genes in the targeted contrast. However, 48 of the 139 targeted DE genes (48/139 = 0.3453) are also DE in the untargeted control (48/260 = 0.1846 of control; Jaccard 48/351 = 0.1368), all 48 in the same direction, so roughly a third of the targeted signal is not clone-specific. Nearest-gene qPCR means are near zero (MAGI3 0.0269, TXNL1 -0.0019, ZNRF4 -0.0210 log2FC, 5 replicates). Proximity analysis of mapped DE genes found no overlap with the candidate and a nearest mapped DE gene (AC011471.1) at 774,116 bp interval gap / 774,117 bp nearest-reference-base distance. These are contextualizing measurements only: control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality, and no global safe label is assigned.

proposal.conclusion: The measured expression changes do not justify excluding candidate olonne-18. The targeted H1 contrast yields 111 qualifying DE genes (54 up, 57 down), which is 149 fewer than the 260 qualifying DE genes in the independent untargeted H1 control contrast (194 up, 66 down). 40 of the 111 targeted DE genes (40/111 = 0.3604) are also significant in the untargeted control, all 40 in the same direction (0 opposite), so a substantial share of the targeted signal is not distinguishable from untargeted-control variation. The nearest mapped DE gene on chr18 is TTC39C at interval_gap_bp 32,399,164 / nearest_reference_base_distance_bp 32,399,165, with no overlap; GREB1L and AP005119.1 are 35,009,358 and 55,176,833 bp away respectively. qPCR means for the nearest genes are near zero (MAGI3 -0.00765, TXNL1 -0.06707, ZNRF4 0.03753 log2FC, 5 replicates). However, no frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, and the required GENCODE v36 criteria (gene-body overlap, TSS, miRNA, lncRNA distances) were not computed for the candidate interval, so the aggregate criteria verdict remains incomplete rather than pass or fail. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality.
